correctness.rationale: Exact Green-function/Parseval decomposition is reconstructed for arbitrary normalized finite-window sources, including both exterior energy branches. The universal exterior bound follows from Cauchy–Schwarz and 2η/(1+η²q²)≤1/q for n≥2. Pointwise optimality at η=1 reduces all normalized packets to the Hermitian Toeplitz maximum. The global multiplier inequalities x/4≤1−σ≤x/4+x²/8 are checked separately on positive and negative wave numbers, and Parseval plus the exact Dirichlet path eigenpair yields matching sharp inequalities, proving π²/[4(K+1)²]+O(K^{-3}). Direct numerical checks are independent corroboration, not a replacement for the arbitrary-K proof. The K=2 matrix and both eigenvalues are evaluated analytically.

originality.rationale: The contribution is the concrete, physically motivated finite-window absorption optimization: the exact K-by-K Toeplitz variational reduction, the uniform bound K/[2π n(n−1)] independent of loss rate and coefficients, the exact K=2 chiral ceiling 2/π, and explicit two-sided finite-K inequalities fixing the leading 1/K² deficit constant. Riberi gives the underlying rank-one boundary Green function and the localized-source absorption integral, but not coherent-window optimization. Parter-type extreme Toeplitz results may imply the leading coefficient after this new physical reduction; no claim is made to a general Toeplitz eigenvalue theorem. Relevant discrete-time coin-state absorption is a different walk. The mathematical and bibliographic residual risks are disclosed.

value.rationale: For an actual quantum-transport control parameter—the number K of coherent preparation sites—this derives an exact nonunit absorption ceiling at every finite K and the sharp coherence resource required to approach total absorption. The K=2 chiral phase raises far-field eventual absorption from the known localized 1−2/π to 2/π, while its opposite phase gives only 2−6/π; the exact K-dependent Dirichlet gap and the uniform finite-distance bound permit meaningful preparation/design tradeoffs. This is neither a free renaming nor an arbitrary table entry; it is a complete natural fixed-window variational problem with physical interpretation.
